name: Firefighter Health & Wellness Conference 2026 (Fairborn, OH)
why: A dedicated firefighter health and wellness conference in Ohio, Oct 14-16, 2026 at the DoubleTree Dayton/Fairborn. The organizer's announcement says each evening has a networking event for all vendors, attendees and speakers, and lists a public media and sponsorship contact (contactus@brothershelpingbrothers.org). The venue is locked in for 2027 and 2028, so a 2026 visit sets up a booth next year.

channel: email listed on site (contactus@brothershelpingbrothers.org, media and sponsorship contact in the announcement)
warm_path: Ohio (Dayton area, near Wright-Patterson); first-responder network
ask: Ask whether a late vendor table or evening-networking pass is still available for 2026, and get on the 2027 vendor list
opener: Hi, I'm the founder of Vybe Health in Akron. We make a screenless band worn overnight that records ECG-based HRV and resting heart rate, built for shift workers who can't wear a watch on the job. I saw the Fairborn conference is Oct 14-16. Is there still room for a small vendor table or a networking pass this year? If not, I'd like to be on the 2027 list.

name: Canton Ruck Run 5K 2026
why: A run-or-ruck 5K on Saturday, November 7, 2026 at Plain Township Memorial Park in Canton, OH, with a dedicated veteran registration rate. Proceeds go to local veterans' groups including the SAM Center and the Stark County Veterans Service Commission. A veteran, rucking crowd 25 minutes from Akron is exactly the tactical early adopter Vybe wants.

name: Ruck-N-Roll Shelby County 2026 (Sidney, OH)
why: A four-hour veteran mental-health ruck march on November 14, 2026 at Tawawa Park in Sidney, OH. Individuals or teams carry a 35-pound ruck and try to cover as many miles as they can in the time limit. It is a tactical, veteran-cause endurance event in Ohio where recovery the night after is the natural talking point.
ask: Offer bands as prizes for the top team, or a small sponsor listing, in return for a post-event recovery-data story with willing ruckers
opener: Hi, I'm the founder of Vybe Health in Akron. We make a screenless band that records HRV and resting heart rate while you sleep. A four-hour, 35-pound ruck is exactly the kind of effort people want to see the night after. Would you take a few bands as prizes for the top team, or a small sponsor spot for Nov 14?

We'd like to support the Cincinnati 5K on Nov 7. Is there a local vendor or community-sponsor option? We'll also put a small team into the virtual run.

Past sponsors include DigiKey (badge components) and Crowd Supply, so a small sponsor or a DevKit demo among badge hackers is realistic.
